findings.why_not_priced: The market extrapolates the habit: five straight beats of 1.0-3.86% (TIKR 2026-10-05) make a ~$25.6-25.9bn print the whisper. premortem.question: Q1
premortem.evidence_already_had: Five straight sales beats of 1.0-3.86%; Tremfya +27% q/q and Caplyta +34% q/q in Q2; Wolk's 'where the analysts are, we should see a number more' on ICOTYDE; management reiterating double-digit growth by decade end.

investment_decision.reason: Every question came back at or near an answer the market holds in numbers. Q1: a ~0.4% beat on a $25.38bn mean. Q2: a raise whose reported size the euro trims, against a street already at the top of the guide. Q3: EPS two-way around $2.53 on the timing of Sail's charge. Q4: no DePuy deal likely on the day. Q5: MedTech flat around 3-4%. The lean is small and negative (impact_sum -0.45, scaled -0.17), far inside the 2.97% implied move on a name whose median reaction is 0.9%, so there is nothing to trade. The no_trade agrees with the sign of impact_sum and reflects its size.
investment_decision.what_would_change_it: A Q3 sales print of $25.8bn or more with the reported FY26 sales midpoint lifted above ~$101.5bn despite the weaker euro (long), or a reported guide cut below $101.1bn / $11.03 (short).
